content: Pole elonzi bise dibundu di Yifese
Temu adji Apolose abile o Korinte, Pole aketabe yinange yi mukongu na aketole o Yifese. Akerasunu badukitsi
na ewivuli: «Dutsidile Yinyuni Yisyeme, ave dutsivayile Fumu yitu?» Bakemuwaghule yi: «Vyaghe! Tukawulu uvose adi Yinyuni Yisyeme.»
Kaboghu Pole akebawivule: «Dubatusu yi dumadile?» Bakewaghule: «Dubatusu du San.»
Pole ebatsinguli: «San amabatise bobamasinge wukalughe mitsanu noghobise Nzambi. Amatsingule batu yiri: “Vayilanu yitu mu Djesu, owurughe va djulu ami.”»
Banomane uwulu bighume byeni, akebabatusu mu dine di Fumu Djesu.
Pole akesakighe makake mu djowu na Yinyuni Yisyeme yike baveghu. Bakevose mu mambembu masusu na bakebighe mu dikabu di Nzambi.
Babaale beni bamabe dighumi na babedji (12) mu botsu.
Kale yilumbu yuvume yi baSwife, Pole amawendaange o ndaghu dusambu. Mu ngondi yiryeru, amabonge mbembu na ngenze. Amavose mu Bukaghe bu Nzambi na amawarise ubawulusu.

BaSwife bamosi bamabuse uvayile yitu, bakepedji abamaduke Nzile Fumu va wusu dibundu. Mba Pole akekakene nowu, akenebeghe badukitsi nandi. Bilumbu byotsu akebavosilaange o ndaghu yinenge dji mutu, benengili Tiranuse.
Dyoni dimatsinge bilime bibedji. Va disukusulu, batu botsu abamatsana mu yari yi Asi, baSwife na bagha baSwife, bakeghulu musamu Fumu.
Bane ba Seva
Nzambi amadughusu bimaghe bineni mu makake ma musatsi andi Pole.
Bamasunzaange miswari vo bikutu abimabembaange dunyuru dwandi mu bibedu. Bibedu byeni bimabelughaange mu mali mowu na binyuni bibi bimapala mu djowu.

BaSwife bamosi, bamawendaange mbure na mbure mu syanze binyuni bibive. Bamaronde usyanze binyuni bibive mu dine di Fumu Djesu. Bamatsingula binyuni bibi: «Nyiduve dirume, dupale mu dine di Djesu adji Pole etubuli!»
Vamabe yivunde yimosi yi bavaghulitsi ba paghu ba baSwife, dine dyandi Seva. Yisambwali yi bane bandi, djowu bamavaghe mambu meni.
Tumbe yilumbu yimosi yinyuni yibi yimabawaghule: «Nyidjabi Djesu na nyidjabi anyi avu Pole. Tumbe djenu, bani duvu?»
Na djandi omabe na yinyuni yibi, akekébwaghe mu djowu mu lase yi abavyoghulile djobotsu mangolu. Amabatsoyise na bukani, na bakerine ndaghu eni, peni-wangi na mapure.
Adimavyoghe dimadjabunu na bise Yifese. BaSwife na baNgereke bamabase na ghome, bakedjabe durumu du Nzambi na buneni bu dine di Fumu Djesu.
Bapwele abamavayile yitu, bamarunga mu yidjabise mabi ame bamavaghaange.
Yinombu yeni yi batu ayimasalise ngalu, bamabeghe mabuku mowu na bamamanyenze va wusu batu botsu. Tumatale dufunu du mabuku meni: dumaveghe dighumi di senzu
(50 000) tsi mbongu.
La nane mu mangolu ma Fumu, musamu wumanyavaange na wumalasaange mangolu mapwele.
Mupuki o musyengi Yifese
Va djulu mambu meni, Pole akeghane kake djutabe Masedwane na Akaye, nowende o Serusaleme. Amavose nane: «Nyinowende, mbé nyutole o musyengi Rome wandi.»
Aketinde o yinange yi Masedwane Timote na Yirase, abamasala yisalu yowu nandi. Tumbe amasyale djabeni mwa temu o yari yi Asi.
Va temu eni, vamabe kimbu djineni o Yifese, dibandu djowu abameneduka Nzile Fumu.
Vamabe mutulitsi bapange, dine dyane Demeteyuse, amavaghe mandaghu magheyi ma nyambi owu mughetu, dine dyandi Artemise. Mandaghu meni mamavegha madile mapwele ombu batulitsi botsu.
Akebaghukighe, na botsu abedjabi yisalu nane yine, na akebatsingule: «Bambatsi, dwidjabi yi maboti meruyili mu yisalu yéyiyi.

Tumbe dwilabi na dwiwulu adivyoyi: mutu awu bénengili Pole etubuli yiri, banyambi abevaghu na makake ma batu, bagha banyambi bangenze! Aborungule ubembe bapwele tsike bu ghunu o Yifese, tumbe na mu yari yetu yotsu yi Asi.
Dyoni mbé dyubivise yisalu yetu, notsyemuse didume di ndaghu nyambi etu Artemise, obeyitsi mbure tsyotsu mu yari yi Asi na mu bulongu bwotsu.»
Mu mambu meni, abamawulu bakebase na kabu na bakeghamughe: «Yivunde djandi, Artemise dji bise Yifese!»
Mupuki wukedughunu mu musyengi wotsu. Batu bakenebeghe Ghayise na Arisitareke, bise Masedwane babedji, bamabe nandi mu mulingu na Pole. Yinombu yikewé mbangu o mbure bibengunu bi mighungi.
Pole amabe na nzale ulabene va wusu yinombu, tumbe badukitsi bakemughandise.
Bidjeti bi Asi bamabe bambatsi bandi, bakemutindile yilumbi yumutsingule, akéwende o mbure bibengunu bi yinombu.
Mu temu eni, dibundu bamabe mu nkumfu. Basusu bamaghamugha dyambu dimosi, bamosi dimosi. Bapwele va ghari owu basamadjabaange dibandu yi bamaghukimine.
BaSwife bamasindighe mutu o wusu, dine dyandi Alesandere. Akenangule dikake mu votse yinombu, mubavosile nobonge dikabu di baSwife.
Tumbe na batu bédjabi yiri muSwife, bakeghamughe djobotsu va mosi mu maweru mabedji: «Yivunde djandi nyambi Artemise dji bise Yifese!»
Anomanisile, yirende-rende yi musyengi akerungule usiyighe yinombu novose: «Bise Yifese, batu botsu bédjabi yi bise Yifese bakelitsi ba ndaghu Artemise, yibaghunu yandi yibonduyi o djulu.
Vagha mutu wughale. Mu dyoni, mbé dusigheme notase ne duke salise.
Dutsibeghe vave batu abaghabunge nosyenge Nzambi etu.
Pa Demeteyuse na bambatsi bandi ba bisalu bane mufundu na mutu, bawendi ombu banzonzi aborungule utabule dyambu. Babeyi mufundu ghune.
Na pa dune dyambu dimosi duvu na nzale ulase, tudinonze va ghari dibundu adiwelmine.
Mbé tufwengululu yiri tudji mimbini, mu dyo ditsivyoghe na nyangu, mbé tughorungule ukekaghule. Va djulu mambu meni, akekungise mughungi.»
